mapper.select: SELECT bs.sleep_no, bs.baby_no, bs.sleep_type, bs.start_time, bs.end_time, bs.reg_time FROM tbl_baby_sleep bs JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bs.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bs.baby_no = #{babyNo} AND bi.email = #{email}

SELECT bs.sleep_no, bs.baby_no, bs.sleep_type, bs.start_time, bs.end_time, bs.reg_time FROM tbl_baby_sleep bs JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bs.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bs.sleep_no = #{sleepNo} AND bi.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_baby_sleep (baby_no, sleep_type, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{babyNo}, #{sleepType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
